agaCurrentCasinoLocations.note: AGA current homepage benchmark; includes commercial and tribal casino locations under its national definition.

nigcFy2025GamingEstablishments.note: NIGC FY2025 independently audited tribal gaming-establishment benchmark.

Michigan.note: 24 tribal Class III casino facilities plus the three state-regulated Detroit commercial casinos.

Ohio.authority: Ohio Casino Control Commission / Ohio Lottery
Ohio.note: Four constitutional casino facilities plus seven VLT racinos.

Indiana.authority: Indiana Gaming Commission / National Indian Gaming Commission
Indiana.note: Thirteen state-regulated casino/racino venues plus Four Winds Casino South Bend.

Illinois.note: Seventeen operating casinos, including Fairmount Park Casino & Racing.

Delaware.note: Three racetrack casinos with table games: Delaware Park, Bally's Dover, and Harrington Raceway & Casino.

West Virginia.note: Four racetrack casinos plus The Casino Club at The Greenbrier; distributed limited-video-lottery retailers are excluded from the physical casino-venue scope.

Missouri.note: Thirteen current licensed riverboat casino properties reconciled to Missouri Gaming Commission operator-license and casino contact records.

Arkansas.authority: Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration / Arkansas Racing Commission
Arkansas.note: Three active casino licensees: Oaklawn Racing Casino Resort, Southland Casino Hotel, and Saracen Casino Resort.

Rhode Island.authority: Rhode Island Department of Business Regulation
Rhode Island.note: Two state casino facilities: Bally's Twin River Lincoln Casino Resort and Bally's Tiverton Casino.

Maine.note: Two licensed casino facilities: Hollywood Casino Bangor and Oxford Casino.

Kansas.authority: Kansas Racing and Gaming Commission / National Indian Gaming Commission
Kansas.note: Four state-owned lottery gaming facilities plus six tribal casino venues; convenience-style gaming outlets are excluded from the destination casino scope.

North Carolina.authority: National Indian Gaming Commission / Tribal operators
North Carolina.note: Two Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians casino resorts plus the Catawba Two Kings introductory casino that opened May 20, 2026; the superseded temporary Two Kings facility is not double-counted.

Virginia.note: Five active casino properties in the July 2026 Virginia Lottery reporting roster: Hard Rock Bristol, Rivers Portsmouth, Caesars Virginia, The Interim Gaming Hall Norfolk, and Live! Virginia Petersburg.

Alabama.authority: National Indian Gaming Commission / Poarch Band of Creek Indians
Alabama.note: Three Poarch Band of Creek Indians Class II casino properties: Wind Creek Atmore, Wind Creek Montgomery, and Wind Creek Wetumpka.

Iowa.authority: Iowa Racing and Gaming Commission / National Indian Gaming Commission
Iowa.note: Nineteen state-licensed casino facilities plus four tribal casino properties: Blackbird Bend, Meskwaki, Prairie Flower, and WinnaVegas.

Kentucky.note: Fourteen active casino-style historical-horse-racing destinations reconciled against the current facility roster and FY2026 HHR wagering reports. Sandy's Racing & Gaming is active in the wagering reports and is included even though the facility page currently places it under quarter-horse tracks rather than repeating it in the HHR subsection.

Louisiana.authority: Louisiana State Police Gaming Operations / National Indian Gaming Commission
Louisiana.note: Twenty state-regulated casino-style properties (15 riverboat/landside casino licenses, Caesars New Orleans, and four racetrack casinos) plus four tribal casino destinations.

California.note: Authoritative active tribal-casino license inventory captured; coordinate activation and the 74-license versus 67-casino compact-definition discrepancy still require reconciliation.
